title: KILLTUBE
synopsis: KILLTUBE is a animated project that exudes the theme "Edopunk". It depicts Tokyo's Shibuya and Shinjuku districts in a parallel world, where the Edo shogunate has closed off Japan and carried on for over four centuries into 2026. In this isolated, stratified society, the only way to change one's standing in life is through participating in live-streamed mortal combat. The battle entertainment story unfolds when an unlikely trio from the lowest depths of society withstand ridicule and aim for the top. As they win over the general public, they discover the hidden truth behind the KILLTUBE system. (Source: Anime News Network, edited)

synopsis: "No matter what happens, I will protect you." Teru Kurebayashi, a high school student, starts to receive emails on the cell phone she received from her late brother Souichirou, her only relative. The emails, sent by a mysterious figure named "Daisy," become her sole support in life following Souichirou's passing. One day, after accidentally breaking a window at school, Teru ends up working for Tasuku Kurosaki, the school custodian. Kurosaki is sharp-tongued and works her to the bone, but for some reason, he kindly looks out for Teru. And after meeting Kurosaki, Teru's fate starts to change drastically... (Source: Dengeki Daisy Official Site)

titleNative: 雑用付与術師が自分の最強に気付くまで
synopsis: Wim Strauss is a “granting caster”—a support mage who can increase the strength of his allies through the power of his spells. It’s a useful talent, but since it can’t be used directly in battle, it gets zero respect from the other members of his party. As far as they’re concerned, support magic is dead weight. It isn’t long before they toss him out on his ear, leaving Wim to wonder if his career as an adventurer is over. Lucky for Wim, he has one big chance: his childhood friend Heidemarie is able to get him an audition with her elite A-rank party, Nachtlibelle. The two of them know his magic is good for more than just menial backup, but now he’ll have to prove it. It’s time to show the world that support mages can do more than just stand on the back lines! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

"The reality found in mankind's future" will be depicted through their perspective. The story will take place over four seasons in the space colony.
